mostWorthwhile.text: Building living bone from supplied cells and a mineralised collagen framework was worthwhile: the planned cutaways distinguish nutrient channels from vessels and connect material properties to bone structure.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial cartilage item description, “smooth, pale caps,” gave little explanation of its function; the sliding-surface inset after fitting it was more informative.

surprise.text: I expected the bone cells to join the collagen framework directly, but compatibility feedback instead linked them to blood vessels and showed nutrients passing through smaller fluid-filled channels.

arbitrary.text: The required order of supplying the bone cells before combining them with the framework was not obvious from the initial descriptions, although the resulting nutrient-pathway illustration gave it a purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: assembling the bone and joint connected structures to their functions, though some terminology and ordering benefited from the result descriptions rather than being clear beforehand.
